name: Infants Due for 2nd DNA PCR
description: Infants List Due for 2nd DNA PCR at 13 weeks of age or completion of breast feeding

baseCohortDefinition.name: Exposed infants due for second PCR (not yet enrolled)

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM person p WHERE p.birthdate >= DATE_SUB(:startDate, INTERVAL 18 MONTH) AND p.birthdate <= :endDate AND p.gender = 'F' AND p.voided = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e1d84780-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d', 'e1d81c60-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d', 'e1d84480-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d')) AND person_id = p.person_id AND value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('703', '664')) AND voided = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'a89a8f20-1350-11df-a1f1-0024e8c6b857') AND person_id = p.person_id AND value_coded = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '1065') AND voided = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o1 WHERE o1.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99436') AND o1.person_id = p.person_id AND o1.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o1.voided = 0) AND p.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND e.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND e.voided = 0) AND (DATE_ADD(p.birthdate, INTERVAL 14 MONTH) <= :endDate OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o2 WHERE o2.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '151283c0-8ef7-442f-8b03-3d7382a9d9cd') AND o2.person_id = p.person_id AND o2.value_datetime <= :endDate AND o2.voided = 0 AND DATE_ADD(o2.value_datetime, INTERVAL 6 WEEK) <= :endDate))

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM person p WHERE p.birthdate >= DATE_SUB(:startDate, INTERVAL 18 MONTH) AND p.birthdate <= :endDate AND p.gender = 'F' AND p.voided = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e1d84780-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d', 'e1d81c60-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d', 'e1d84480-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d')) AND person_id = p.person_id AND value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('703', '664')) AND voided = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'a89a8f20-1350-11df-a1f1-0024e8c6b857') AND person_id = p.person_id AND value_coded = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '1065') AND voided = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o1 WHERE o1.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99436') AND o1.person_id = p.person_id AND o1.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o1.voided = 0) AND p.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND e.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND e.voided = 0) AND (DATE_ADD(p.birthdate, INTERVAL 14 MONTH) <= :endDate OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o2 WHERE o2.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '151283c0-8ef7-442f-8b03-3d7382a9d9cd') AND o2.person_id = p.person_id AND o2.value_datetime <= :endDate AND o2.voided = 0 AND DATE_ADD(o2.value_datetime, INTERVAL 6 WEEK) <= :endDate))

SELECT CONCAT(pn.given_name, ' ', pn.family_name) FROM obs o INNER JOIN person_relationship pr ON o.person_id = pr.person_a AND pr.voided = 0 INNER JOIN person p ON pr.person_b = p.person_id INNER JOIN person_name pn ON p.person_id = pn.person_id WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99776') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.value_text FROM obs o INNER JOIN person_relationship pr ON o.person_id = pr.person_a AND pr.voided = 0 INNER JOIN person p ON pr.person_b = p.person_id LEFT JOIN person_attribute pa ON p.person_id = pa.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 WHERE pa.person_attribute_type_id = 14 AND o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99776') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pi.identifier FROM obs o INNER JOIN person_relationship pr ON o.person_id = pr.person_a AND pr.voided = 0 INNER JOIN person p ON pr.person_b = p.person_id INNER JOIN patient_identifier pi ON p.person_id = pi.patient_id AND pi.voided = 0 INNER JOIN patient_identifier_type pit ON pi.identifier_type = pit.patient_identifier_type_id WHERE pit.uuid = 'e1731641-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115' AND o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99776') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99606') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99435') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '99451') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '151283c0-8ef7-442f-8b03-3d7382a9d9cd') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) THEN DATE_ADD((SELECT o.value_datetime FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '151283c0-8ef7-442f-8b03-3d7382a9d9cd') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1), INTERVAL 6 WEEK) ELSE DATE_ADD(p.birthdate, INTERVAL 14 MONTH) END FROM person p WHERE p.person_id = :patientId
